hypothesis: Pairwise BPR is the remaining top-priority ranking-aligned loss not yet tried, and it matches GAUC especially directly because both depend on ordering positives above negatives within each user. Since prior listwise variants underperformed the FM baseline, the next clean test is to isolate loss alignment with minimal confounding changes: keep the simple FM and no history, but add two-stage fine-tuning so embeddings first learn stable pointwise signals and then are refined for within-user ranking. I expect this to help more than changing model capacity, and it could recover some nDCG@5 by sharpening positive-vs-negative separation near the top of each user list.
expected_effect: +0.002 to +0.006 primary versus the current best 0.5992 if BPR aligns better with GAUC; plausible range around GAUC +0.003 to +0.008 with flat to slightly positive nDCG@5.
decide_reason: only 3 attempts exist (< draft_count=7); drafting a fresh combination, prioritizing untried high-priority axes
